title: Primary isolation of vascular cells from murine brain for single cell sequencing
protocol: Mix 2850 µl of buffer 2 with 75 µl of buffer 1 for 600 mg of tissue.
Warm the enzyme mix 1 for 10 minutes at 37 ºC.
Kill the mouse using an approved method of euthanasia.
Remove the brain from the skull.
Transfer the brain to a Petri dish and chop it with sharp scissors for about 30 seconds, or until no large pieces are visible.
Transfer the brain pieces to a 5 ml tube and mix them with enzyme mix 1.
Use a p1000 with cut tip and wash the petri dish.
Incubate for 17 minutes at 37 ºC with slow rotation.
Prepare enzyme mix 2: Mix 30 µl of buffer 3 with 15 µl of buffer 4.
Take the suspension from the rotator and add enzyme mix 2.
Mix the solution with a Pasteur pipette and a rubber bulb 10 times.
Incubate for 12 minutes at 37 ºC with slow rotation.
Pass the brain suspension through a 20 G needle at least 10 times without creating bubbles or foam.
Incubate the suspension for 10 minutes at 37 ºC.
Transfer the suspension to a 50 ml tube and add 20 ml of cold PBS with Mg and Ca.
Pass the mixture through a 70 µm mesh.
Spin down the suspension at 300g for 5 minutes at 4 ºC.
Resuspend the pellet in 1800 µl of MACS buffer and 200 µl of Myelin removal beads.
Incubate the mixture at 4 ºC for 15 minutes without agitation.
Add 18 ml of MACS buffer to a total volume of 20 ml.
Spin down the mixture at 300g for 5 minutes at  4 ºC.
Rinse each LS column with 3 ml of MACS buffer and discard eluent.
Resuspend the pellet in 3 ml of MACS buffer.
Add 1 ml of cell suspension to each LS column and collect the eluent containing cells.
Wash each column twice with 1 ml of MACS buffer, collecting the eluent each time.
Spin down the collected eluents at 300g for 5 minutes.
Dissolve the pellet in 500 µl of FACS buffer.
Incubate the mixture with FACS antibodies or proceed directly to FACS analysis.
